Standard clustering evaluation metrics are used: Jaccard, Adjusted Rand Index (ARI), Normalized Mutual Information (NMI), to compare the attribute assignments on gold spans; Recall, to evaluate gold cluster coverage.
Two in-house annotators are asked to annotate all spans that appear as reasonable attribute values of either an existing type from the seed set, or a brand-new type that fits the context.
guideline: Annotators are asked to annotate all spans that appear as reasonable attribute values of either an existing type from the seed set, or a brand-new type that fits the context. As with previous works, we do not allow overlapping spans: more complete spans are preferred over shorter and incomplete spans; each span is assigned a single attribute type that best describes its property.
